resources.string: Watches the remote\'s volume and mute keys and shows the soundbar\'s real volume on screen. Key presses are passed through unchanged; nothing else is read.
Shows your soundbar\'s real volume whenever you press volume on the remote.
Enable \"Theatre Bar volume overlay\" under Accessibility. If the switch is greyed out, open App info for this app and choose \"Allow restricted settings\" first.
Only used as a fallback. Many Android TV builds hide this screen.
The volume comes from the soundbar itself via HDMI eARC (CEC). Nothing to configure; the soundbar just has to be on.
Remembers the soundbar volume you set in each app and HDMI input (YouTube, Netflix, PlayStation …) and restores it when you switch there. Pressing a volume key during the adjustment stops it.
Nothing remembered yet. Just set the volume you like in an app.
Handle volume keys in this app

While the soundbar is on, volume up/down are applied by this app instead of the TV. No accidental mute on a quick double "down", and holding a key keeps changing the volume. Mute stays on the mute key.
For Google TV remotes, whose Netflix button the TV otherwise ignores.
No soundbar active. Turn it on and play something through it.
This TV hides that screen. Use the adb command from the README.
